definitions.explanation: Something that happens without warning or preparation. Often used in the pattern {不意|ふい}を{突|つ}く (to catch off guard) or {不意|ふい}に (suddenly, unexpectedly).

examples.japanese: {不意|ふい}に{声|こえ}をかけられた。
examples.english: Someone suddenly called out to me.

examples.japanese: {不意|ふい}の{来客|らいきゃく}に{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by an unexpected visitor.

examples.japanese: {不意|ふい}を{突|つ}かれて、{何|なに}も{言|い}い{返|かえ}せなかった。
examples.english: I was caught off guard and couldn't say anything back.

notes:
PATTERNS:
- {不意|ふい}に: suddenly, unexpectedly (adverbial use)
- {不意|ふい}を{突|つ}く: to catch off guard, to take by surprise
- {不意|ふい}の〜: unexpected ~ (adjectival use with の)

WORD FORMATION:
{不|ふ} (not) + {意|い} (intention, expectation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不意|ふい}の{訪問|ほうもん}: unexpected visit
- {不意|ふい}を{突|つ}かれる: to be caught off guard
- {不意|ふい}に{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}る: tears come unexpectedly
